text: OMP is a brand of Racing Force S.p.A., a company listed on Euronext Growth Milan whose shareholder table lists SAYE S.p.A., a family holding company, as its largest shareholder with 49.27% of the share capital.
short: OMP is a brand of Racing Force S.p.A.; SAYE S.p.A. holds 49.27%.

source.name: Racing Force Group: Group (Who we Are)

source.quote: Through its portfolio of brands – including OMP, Bell Racing, Zeronoise, and Racing Spirit – equips professional drivers

additionalSources.name: Racing Force Group: Shareholders' Information
additionalSources.note: Page without a date; opened 2026-10-03. The page's shareholder table lists SAYE S.p.A. with 13,566,895 shares, 49.27% of the share capital; it also describes Racing Force S.p.A. financial instruments as admitted to trading on Euronext Growth Milan.

additionalSources.name: Racing Force S.p.A.: SAYE S.p.A. letter depositing a board-list (PDF)
additionalSources.note: Letter of 22 April 2024 from SAYE S.p.A. (signed by its legal representative Piero Paolo Delprato) depositing a candidate list for Racing Force S.p.A.'s Board of Directors; the attached CV states Delprato is Chairman and CEO of both companies. The same letter states SAYE held 52.7% of the share capital in April 2024; the current shareholder table shows 49.27%.
additionalSources.quote: Chairman and CEO of SAYE S.p.A. (Family Holding Company) Chairman and CEO of Racing Force S.p.A. (parent company of Racing Force Group)
